marta: starting canary for Seabreeze-14b (int4). hitting warm-start OOMs and sustained gpu_heap_frag on long streams (~1200+ tokens). posting quick notes + tiny logs.syl: any repro steps? which GPUs?marta: single stream, target gen 1200-1600 tokens. repro on both A100/H100. microbatch=1 reproduces fastest.dan: can you paste the allocator snippet?ops-bot: Canary created: seabreeze-14b-int4 @ pool-theta (8 replicas).marta: log at fail:
```
[E] cudaMalloc failed: OutOfMemory
needed 1.1GiB for attn_kv
allocator: free_chunks=9, largest_free=48MiB
frag_metric: gpu_heap_frag=0.82 -> stays >0.7 after first heavy request
```
syl: pattern looks like small-chunk fragmentation from repeated KV slot allocations. int4 reduces size but increases boundary allocations. two low-risk knobs: soft-reserve + preemptive-evict on warm path.syl: propose defaults: max_new_tokens=400, soft_reserve_per_replica=200MiB, preemptive_kv_eviction=true, prefetch=false on warm-start.marta: also recommend a short startup-prime (100 tokens) and enable slab_compact_on_eviction for this model.dan: microbatch policy: keep microbatch=1 for latency, but allow batching_window=15ms, max_concurrent=3 for brief consolidation to cut alloc churn.syl: add cudaMallocRetry backoff (3 retries with 50ms) to reduce hot-path OOM noise and give evict a chance.leo: run an A/B overnight. control: current config (max_new=1024, no soft reserve, prefetch=true). variant: syl's config. collect alloc_hist, frag_time_series, OOM_events per replica every 5m, and end-to-end quality on conv-bench-1k (BLEU+LLMScore).marta: command I'm using:
```
./seabreeze_canary --model seabreeze-14b --quant int4 \
  --ctrl "max_new=1024,prefetch=true,soft_reserve=0,slab_compact=false" \
  --var  "max_new=400,prefetch=false,soft_reserve=200MiB,preemptive_evict=true,slab_compact=true,startup_prime=100,malloc_retries=3" \
  --workload long-stream --duration 10h \
  --collect alloc_hist:5m --collect frag_ts:5m --trace oom_stack
```
dan: capture per-replica steady-state frag and also token-emission rate. if variant reduces sustained frag and OOMs without >10% quality delta, proceed.syl: rollout plan if good: extend canary 12h, then 25% (24h), 75% (24h), full. include auto-fallback to fp16 if OOM rate > 0.3% or P95 latency regresses > 25%.marta: I'll pin a debug node for live cudaMalloc traces if we need deep inspection. tagging @leo for allocation.leo: good. also log kernel/driver versions to rule out driver-related allocator bugs.dan: if tail OOMs persist after these changes, next actions: increase soft_reserve, add per-slot slab pooling to reduce free-list fragmentation, or try kernel-affinity for the allocator thread (bench first).marta: starting job now. will post summarized plots (frag timeline, alloc hist, OOM counts, quality diffs) at 6300045000. :rocket:
